stemMd: Exactly one of two statements is true: “The parcel is in room 1” and “The parcel is not in room 2.” The parcel is in exactly one of rooms 1, 2 or 3. Where is it?
explanationMd: Test the three permitted locations. Room 1 makes both statements true; room 2 makes both false. Room 3 makes “in room 1” false and “not in room 2” true, satisfying the condition. Exhausting the three locations establishes uniqueness.

distractorRationale.c: Both statements would be true if the parcel were in room 1.
distractorRationale.e: Both statements would be false if the parcel were in room 2.
distractorRationale.d: Both possibilities violate the exactly-one-true condition.
distractorRationale.a: Room 3 makes the first statement false and the second true.
